ecommerce_revenue.text:
Description: The revenue change in the food e-commerce market in the United Arab Emirates was forecast to continuously decrease between 2024 and 2029 by in total 25.8 percentage points. According to this forecast, in 2029, the indicator will have decreased for
the fifth consecutive year to 6.97 percent. Read more
Note(s): 2018 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

pandemic. Read more

forecast_users.text:
Description: The real total consumer spending on clothing and footwear in the United Arab Emirates was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2029 by in total 1.3 billion U.S. dollars (+12.49 percent). After the ninth consecutive increasing year, the real
fashion-related spending is estimated to reach 11.5 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2029. Read more
Note(s): United Arab Emirates; 2014 to 2029; all values are estimates
Source(s): Statista
